Uploading a file to your JobNimbus account is a 2 part process. You first have to get a Presigned URL that you can then use to PUT your file into the system. There are 2 endpoints to use depending on the size of the file to upload. If the file is <100MB, you should use the si

}

endpoints.description:
Endpoint Overview
This endpoint is used to complete the file upload process for a specific file identified by jnid. It allows you to finalize the upload and optionally generate a thumbnail for the uploaded file.
Request Method
POST
Request URL
https://api.jobnimbus.com/files/v1/uploads/:jnid/complet

Endpoint Overview
This endpoint allows users to upload multiple URLs to the JobNimbus API. It is designed to facilitate the management of file uploads by associating them with specific resources or entities within the JobNimbus system.
Request Method
POST
Request URL
https://api.jobnimbus.com/files/
endpoints.example_body:
{
    "partCount": (number, required),
    "fileSize": (number, required),
    "isPrivate": (boolean, required),
    "related": [
        (array of strings, required)
    ],
    "type": (number, required),
    "filename": (string, required),
    "description": (string, required)
}

endpoints.description:
Endpoint Overview
This endpoint is designed to complete a multi-part file upload process in the JobNimbus API. It allows users to finalize the upload of files that have been previously initiated in multiple parts.
Request Method

Request URL
https://api.jobnimbus.com/files/v1/uploads/:jnid/compl

Endpoint Overview
This endpoint allows users to abort a multi-file upload process. It is particularly useful when there are multiple files being uploaded and the user decides to cancel the operation.
Request Method
POST
Request URL
